_comment: The Midgard node this explorer build is known to read.
nodeSchema.fingerprint covers table and column names for the relations the
read path queries, taken from NODE_TABLES in backend/src/server/probes.ts.
Regenerate it from the committed schema fixture with: pnpm compat write --fixture
backend/src/db/manifest.ts, which is the value the backend enforces.
testedCompatibilityRevision is the Midgard commit the vendored packages and
the schema fixture were built from, and what was tested against a deployment.
verifiedAgainst names the deployment this build was actually run against.

midgard.commitNote: Not pinned. This is the revision of the node build being run, and it comes from that build's record. The running Preprod node's image carries no revision label, so it is not known; testedCompatibilityRevision is what was tested, not what was built.

testedCompatibilityRevision.note: Built for preprod-testing, its core verifies the live Preprod manifest c3d841f2e75d61e90a394f36789ea79d67bfac7801aed325ca552dfb5b8fbfbb and decodes the deployment's one transaction, UTxO and withdrawal; its migrations 0001 to 0027 give the live node schema. The node's /protocol-info consensus profile equals this commit's. b9511834c rejects the same manifest on consensusProfile.limits.maxCekBuiltinTag (100 against 86).

verifiedAgainst.note: The deployment the read path and the L1 index were exercised against.
